name: Ueno Koyori
source:
A girl who acts like all the air's leaking from her head.

While at first she seems stupid, sometimes she makes biting observations. She's a part of the archery club.

[Translated from [url=http://craftwork.product.co.jp/CATALOG/adieu/chara/chara_05.html]official profile[/url].]
